metadata.one_direction: ships[*] is the only stored direction: homeports, typical_ports (the headline subset a ship page shows) and also_calls_at (every other recorded call). port_to_ships is generated by admin/lexicon/deployments.mjs; edit ships[*], never port_to_ships.
